headline: Congress renamed a Boston post office lobby after John F. Kennedy in 2018.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Postal Service facility at 25 New Chardon Street Lobby in Boston, Massachusetts, the "John Fitzgerald Kennedy Post Office." It is a naming measure only and does not change postal services, rules, or costs. Mail delivery and post office operations stay the same.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 23, 2018.
